positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I built and enhanced the web applications and services behind the online self-service functionality for Apple order status, history, tracking, trade-ins, returns, etc on the Apple Online Store (www.apple.com). I developed key retail features for enriched customer experiences including Apple Store Pickup, Activation Lock check, Apple Trade-In, and the iPhone Upgrade Program. To build these features, our team augmented our intricate e-commerce microservice architecture for multiple clients and created web application-specific business logic. 

I shipped code to production consistently for high visibility customer experiences and provided production support for 15+ high-traffic, mission-critical product launches on the Apple Online Store during EMEA hours. Our geographically-distributed team meant close collaboration across multiple timezones with business, product, design, security and engineering teams. 

As a mid-level engineer, I mentored junior engineers internally, fostered inclusivity among Apple interns and women engineers, and also conducted technical interviews for external and internal senior software engineer candidates.
positions.insights: Skills: Web Engineering · Software Infrastructure · Software Industry · Engineering · Software Design

positions.title: Catalog Content Contributor
positions.description: I crafted educational content (lessons, quizzes, articles) for online computer science courses accessible to Codecademy's 50 million users across 190+ countries. I developed advanced coding questions and instructional content for complex topics including technical Java interview preparation tactics, machine learning, and natural language processing.

positions.title: Content Associate
positions.description: I created online skill paths and lessons for Codecademy user courses teaching Python, data structures (heaps, stacks, hashmaps, graphs) and algorithms. I used my teaching and coding skills to brainstorm new ways to engage learners.

positions.title: Linguistics Research Assistant
positions.description: I worked in the UC Berkeley Linguistics Department in an Electromagnetic Articulography Data Processing Research Lab. I conducted experiments on participants to measure their articulatory movements as well as facial movements while they spoke. This was done with the NDI Wave Speech Research system. I also adjusted automatic acoustic alignments using the Praat software system.
positions.insights: Skills: Linguistics · Praat Software System · Acoustic analysis · Audio Recording

positions.title: Teaching Assistant — Intro to Python
positions.description:
I taught Python to top 6th-9th grade students from schools in Sacramento for this fast-paced summer school program, helped create advanced homework problems related to logic problems, ciphers, & probability games.

I also worked part-time in the administrative offices of the CSU Sacramento Summer Youth Academy Program which offered the Introduction to Python course.
positions.insights: Skills: Teaching · Lesson Planning · Python (Programming Language) · High School Students

positions.title: Congressional Intern
positions.description: I worked at Congresswoman Doris Matsui's office in Sacramento. I learned about immigration policies, as well as veteran and senior related issues that people face in my community. I spoke with many constituents each day and helped figure out how to approach their problems and how the Congresswoman could help them. I was well-versed in the Congresswoman's stance on important local and federal policies, and shared them with constituent callers. I was a part of weekly office meetings, some of which the Congresswoman attended.
positions.insights: Skills: American Government · Constituency Outreach · Congressional Affairs · Project Management

positions.title: Public Policy Intern
positions.description: I spread awareness of the Alzheimer's Association in CA state legislative offices, and met with policy specialists regarding state bills I researched which intended to increase Alzheimer's research.  I also attended the Annual CA Alzheimer's Disease Center Conference, where I learned about progress being made to decrease the rates of the disease. At the end of my work, I wrote a report on the work the Association had done in the past month related to bills, legislators, research funding, etc.
positions.insights: Skills: Policy Advocacy · State Policy · Public Sector · Congressional Lobbying · Writing · Research Skills

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: In this position, I learned Ruby on Rails, shadowed a senior SWE, and participated in weekly company stand-ups where the next week's plans of action were discussed.
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby on Rails · Attention to Detail · Software Industry · Harassment training · Workplace Culture

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: I worked at the UC Davis MIND Institute on a research team that strives to improve the lives of children and adults who have problems with behavioral disorders such as inattention, impulsivity, emotional regulation, and ADHD. The goal is to create treatments that decrease the severity of such behavioral disorders and find the cause of them. In my position, I created an Android video game on Android Studio to test attention spans, analyzed surveys completed by parents and children, helped organize data dictionaries, and observed patient visits.
positions.insights: Skills: Android Studio · Java · Patient Assessment · Data Dictionary · Clinical Research

positions.title: Assistant Swim Coach
positions.description: I grew up swimming on the Sutter Lawn team and then transitioned into coaching. I loved coaching as I was able to interact with and teach children on a regular basis over many years and get lots of Vitamin D. I conducted swim practices independently, managing groups of up to 50 children in the pool at times. I learned the best ways to interact with eagerly involved parents and earned the respect of the children of all age groups. Additionally, I taught private individual swim lessons to children aged 4-13 and served as a lifeguard periodically.
positions.insights: Skills: Swim Instruction · Working with Children · Team Leadership · Lifeguarding · Swim Lessons · Sports Coaching

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: In this position, I assisted with water sample collection of temperature, depth and pressure data in the American River. I also digitized hydrologic data for use in sediment control projects of Donner Lake.
positions.insights: Skills: Computer Information Systems · Water Analysis · Geographic Information Systems (GIS)
